endpoints.name: CreateFactoryMapping
endpoints.business_purpose: Create factory mappings for a user. Replaces existing mappings for the user with new factory IDs.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new factory mappings for user. First deletes all existing mappings for the user, then creates new ones for each factory ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User (creator) exists. Selected user exists. At least one factory ID provided. Factories must exist.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. selecteduserId > 0. User exists. At least one factory ID. Factories exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Existing mappings deleted. New mappings created. Audit log created for each successful mapping.
business_logic.state_changes: FactoryMapping: DELETE; FactoryMapping: INSERT; AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Valid selected user ID is required.
At least one factory ID is required.
message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Deletes and recreates mappings. Multiple calls delete intermediate mappings.

endpoints.short_description: Create factory mappings for a user. Replaces existing mappings for the user with new factory IDs.
endpoints.detailed_description: Create factory mappings for a user. Replaces existing mappings for the user with new factory IDs. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactoryMapping.GetUserById, IFactoryMapping.GetFactoriesByUserId, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: FactoryMapping: DELETE, FactoryMapping: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Valid selected user ID is required. [when request.selecteduserId <= 0]; At least one factory ID is required. [when request.factoryid == null || request.factoryid.Count == 0]; User(s) not found or inactive. [when creator == null || selectedUser == null]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
